published.citation: Damasso et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 224018 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive: 5784 +/- 60 K, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A.118D/abstract

temperature.note: No archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: HD 224018 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), so the colour is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
